text: pkill -x vlc; sleep 2; f=~/.config/vlc/vlcrc; mkdir -p ~/.config/vlc; touch $f; grep -q '^#*qt-bgcone=' $f && sed -i 's/^#*qt-bgcone=.*/qt-bgcone=0/' $f || printf '[qt]\nqt-bgcone=0\n' >> $f; grep -n qt-bgcone $f
memo: Typed the fix in the terminal: killed VLC, then set qt-bgcone=0 in ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc (appending [qt] section if the key was absent), ending with a grep to confirm. If a further step exists, read the terminal output to verify it prints qt-bgcone=0.
